'''''Escudella i carn d'olla''''', or shorter '''''escudella''''' ({{IPA|ca|əskuˈðeʎə|label=Eastern Catalan:}}; {{literally|bowl}}), is a traditional [[Catalan cuisine|Catalan]] and [[Valencian cuisine|Valencian]] [[soup]] made with [[meat]] and [[Vegetable|vegetables]].<ref>{{cite book | last=Ichijo | first=A. | last2=Johannes | first2=V. | last3=Ranta | first3=R. | title=The Emergence of National Food: The Dynamics of Food and Nationalism | publisher=Bloomsbury Publishing | year=2019 | isbn=978-1-350-07414-9 | url=https://books.google.com/books?id=TKJ-DwAAQBAJ&pg=PA90 | access-date=20 June 2019 | page=90}}</ref> [[Francesc Eiximenis]] wrote in the 14th century that it was eaten every day by Catalan people.<ref name=fabrega>''Totes les sopes: Brous, escudelles i sopes d'arreu'', de [[Jaume Fàbrega]]. Cossetània Edicions, 2008. {{ISBN|978-84-9791-394-2}} {{in lang|ca}}</ref>

It is characterized by the use of a '''''pilota''''', a very big meatball spiced with garlic and parsley; it also contains vegetables as celery, cabbage, carrots, etc.<ref name="Song Riera 2019"/> depending on the season. Additionally, bones, sausages called ''[[botifarra]]'', and other types of meat, can be used.
